name: Selvage Club
character: An energetic urban scrap club with zine graphics, direct language, and zero preciousness.

sections.title: YOUR SCRAPS ARE THE GOOD FABRIC.
sections.subtitle: Selvage Club turns narrow strips, odd cuts, and almost-nothings into very definite quilts.
